propositions: CLI --timeout flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes permanently shadow per-test budget changes in pyproject.toml because workflow files execute from trusted main while ini changes come with patchsets
pytest-timeout precedence (CLI > env > ini) means a patchset modifying the ini timeout budget cannot exercise its own Verified run when the CLI flag is present

Removing --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread from both default-suite and integration lanes in _build-and-test.yml allows the ini config to govern timeout behavior, matching scikit-learn/pandas/numpy precedent
The ini already carries timeout=300 and timeout_method=thread, so removal changes only the authority (from CLI to ini) without altering the effective shared-tier budget
The conftest-floor hardening mechanism (branch preserve/timeout-floor-hardening) is rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config at session start read-only with no supported hook point
